title: Lesson 6. Keyboard trainer
description: How to sit, where fingers live and your first speed record

questions.prompt: Which keys have bumps for the index fingers?
questions.explain: You can find them even with your eyes closed.

questions.prompt: Match the hand with its home keys
You can sit at the computer with a crooked back — it doesn't matter.
questions.explain: Keep your back straight or it will get tired.

questions.text: Elbows like a ___ — at a right angle.

questions.prompt: What do we praise in the trainer?
Put the record steps in order
The bumps on А and О help you find the home keys without looking.
questions.explain: You feel them with your index fingers.

learn.intro: Today we train like athletes: sit right, put our fingers home and set a first record!

slides.text: So your back and eyes don't get tired: straight back, feet on the floor, screen an arm's length away, elbows like a robot — at a right angle.

check.prompt: How far should the screen be?
check.explain: That way your eyes don't get tired.

slides.text: Fingers have a home. The **А** and **О** keys have little bumps — you can find them with your eyes closed. Your index fingers live there.
Left hand — **Ф Ы В А**, right hand — **О Л Д Ж**. Thumbs — on the space bar.

check.prompt: Thumbs rest on the space bar.
check.explain: The other fingers sit on their home keys.

slides.text: We practise in a trainer for 15 minutes. We praise fingers staying home, not speed.
Contest: type a familiar text for 1 minute and count the words. Write down the record and check every 2 weeks!

check.prompt: How often do we check typing speed?
check.explain: That shows how the number grows.
